install_path: External boot must be allowed in Startup Security Utility

install_path: Asahi installer run from macOS by the owner
bootloader_requirement: Owner sets reduced security for the Asahi volume via the official installer
prerequisites: Working macOS install and owner admin password; Activation Lock cleared by the owner
notes: ReuseOS apps not yet packaged for Fedora Asahi

prerequisites: Device out of enterprise enrolment; owner consent; model listed as supported by MrChromebox
notes: Firmware flashing is destructive and needs explicit authorisation
